jobs.description_text: Dark Wolf is hiring in Ogden, Utah for a Security Controls Assessor Representative (SCAR). This position works with fellow SCARs, Security Controls Assessors (SCAs), Information System Security Managers (ISSM), Program Managers (PM), and Authorizing Official (AO) representatives to obtain and maintain Authority toOperate (ATO) approvals for various AFNWC weapon subsystems and supporting IT systems by adhering to the Risk Management Framework (RMF). This position is responsible for reviewing, assessing, and providing advice/recommendations to the SCA/AO throughout the RMF process for assigned programs. This is an on-site position on Hill Air Force Base. Required Qualifications: 10+ years of relevant work experience, including experience as an ISSO, ISSM, SCA, SCAR, or similar roles. Mastery of the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), including all seven steps and in-depth knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 security controls and their application to complex government information systems. Comprehensive technical understanding and practical experience with Windows/Linux OS hardening (including STIGs), network protocols (TCP/IP), firewall configurations, IDS/IPS, cloud security (FedRAMP, AWS/Azure GovCloud), virtualization, and database security. Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning (ACAS/Tenable.sc/Nessus), configuration assessment (SCAP/STIG tools), and log analysis/SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Elastic Stack) to identify and evaluate security posture. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Infrastructure
jobs.description_text: The Team: The Infrastructure Team builds the foundation that enables enterprise AI to operate reliably at scale. Supporting complex machine learning workloads, massive data processing demands, and hundreds of enterprise customers, our engineers solve challenging problems across cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, scalability, and performance. From optimizing cloud-native architectures to enabling high-performance AI/ML workloads, the team is responsible for creating the resilient, secure, and scalable infrastructure that powers our next generation of enterprise AI capabilities. jobs.title: Team Lead, Client Success
jobs.description_text: Team Lead - Client Success EnergyHub’s Client Success team launches and operates best-in-class programs for utilities, helping them address grid challenges by engaging customers with connected devices. As a Team Lead - Client Success, helping our clients and your team achieve their goals is your mandate. This position requires a player-coach leadership style with direct contributions balanced by tactical leadership of a team. What you’ll do Own success for your region. Take responsibility for the Northeast regions’ P&L by driving revenue, managing ARR to meet or exceed company targets, developing and implementing strategies to grow accounts for long-term value and client satisfaction, and serving as the first escalation point for client issues to ensure timely and effective resolution.
